points.description: States "Method of moments" (equating sample moments to population/distribution moments) as one method, using the correct technical name.
States "Method of maximum likelihood" (maximum likelihood estimation) as the other method, using the correct technical name.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both exact methods named: method of moments and method of maximum likelihood. Each method is worth 1 mark; a vague, generic or misnamed method (e.g. least squares, graphical method, probability weighted moments) earns nothing for that point. A wrong extra method listed alongside the two correct ones costs one point.
